release_notes:
🚀 New Features:
✅ Groq AI Whisper Large v3 Turbo - បន្ថែម Groq transcription model (API-based, FAST & FREE!)
✅ AssemblyAI Integration - បន្ថែម AssemblyAI models (Best & Nano) with word-level timestamps
✅ Simplified UI - រៀបចំ interface សម្រួលប្រើប្រាស់ជាងមុន

🗑️ Removed Features (Performance Optimization):
❌ Local Whisper Model - ដកចេញ offline Whisper models ដើម្បីកាត់បន្ថយទំហំកម្មវិធី
❌ PyTorch/CUDA Dependencies - លុបបំបាត់ torch, torchvision, torchaudio (~6GB saved!)
❌ GPU Detection System - លុប CUDA/GPU auto-detection code
❌ Device Selector - លុប CPU/GPU dropdown selector
❌ Timing Adjustment Buttons - លុប -0.2s និង +0.2s buttons
❌ Smart Sync Button - លុប auto-timing sync feature
❌ Preview Button - លុប video preview button

🎨 UI/UX Improvements:
✅ Import/Export SRT Buttons - ផ្លាស់ទីមកខាងក្រោម bottom bar
✅ Cleaner Top Bar - មានតែ buttons សំខាន់ៗ (Load, Model Selector, Transcribe)
✅ Simplified Bottom Bar - Import SRT | Export SRT | Remove Vocal | Export MP3 | Export Video | CapCut
✅ Fixed QComboBox Visibility - កែ model selector text ឲ្យឃើញច្បាស់

⚡ Performance Improvements:
✅ 6GB+ Disk Space Saved - មិនត្រូវ install heavy ML libraries
✅ Faster Startup Time - program ចាប់ផ្តើមលឿនជាង
✅ Lower RAM Usage - ប្រើ RAM តិចជាងមុន
✅ Smaller Installation Size - file exe តូចជាងមុន

🌐 Transcription Models Available:
• Gemini 2.0 Flash (Online, FREE, 80+ languages)
• Gemini 1.5 Flash (Online, FREE)
• Gemini 1.5 Pro (Online, high quality)
• Groq Whisper Large v3 Turbo (API, FREE, ultra-fast)
• Groq Whisper Large v3 (API, FREE)
• AssemblyAI Best (API, highest accuracy, word timestamps)
• AssemblyAI Nano (API, 8x faster, 6x cheaper)

💡 Note:
កម្មវិធី version នេះ focus លើ cloud-based transcription models ដែល:
✅ Free ឬ very affordable
✅ មិនត្រូវការ GPU
✅ លឿន និងត្រឹមត្រូវខ្ពស់
✅ Support multi-language

instructions.note: Upload file នេះទៅ GitHub repository ហើយ អ្នកប្រើប្រាស់នឹងទទួលបាន updates ស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ
